title: S.I. No. 13 of 2026 - Value Added Tax Act (Alteration of Rate of Interest) Order
text:
101
Value Added Tax Act - Resolution of the House of Assembly to approve
the draft Value Added Tax (Alteration of Rate of Interest) Order
SAINT LUCIA
STATUTORY INSTRUMENT, 2026, No. 13
[ 16th February, 2026 ]
RESOLUTION
WHEREAS it is provided under section 33(1) of the Value Added
Tax Act, Cap. 15.42 (the Act) that tax payable under the Act which
is not paid by the date on which it becomes due and payable bears
interest at the rate of one point two five per cent per month or part of
a month for the period during which it remains unpaid;
AND WHEREAS it is provided under section 33(2) of the Act that
the Minister responsible for Finance may, subject to the affirmative
resolution of the House of Assembly and by Order, alter the rate of
interest under the Act;
AND WHEREAS the Minister of Finance seeks approval of the
draft Value Added Tax (Alteration of Rate of Interest) Order by an
affirmative resolution of the House of Assembly to alter, from 2nd day
of May, 2024 to the 1st day of May, 2026, the rate of interest from one
point two five per cent to zero per cent on tax payable which is not
paid by the date on which it becomes due and payable for the period
during which it remains unpaid for the tax periods before and ending
on the 31st day of December, 2023;

102
Value Added Tax Act - Resolution of the House of Assembly to approve
the draft Value Added Tax (Alteration of Rate of Interest) Order
BE IT RESOLVED that the House of Assembly by affirmative
resolution approves the draft Value Added Tax (Alteration of Rate
of Interest) Order which alters, from 2nd day of May, 2024 to the 1st
day of May, 2026, the rate of interest from one point two five per
cent to zero per cent on tax payable which is not paid by the date
on which it becomes due and payable for the period during which it
remains unpaid for the tax periods before and ending on the 31st day
of December, 2023.
Passed in the House of Assembly this 3rd day of February, 2026.
CLAUDIUS J. FRANCIS,
Speaker of the House of Assembly.
Passed in the Senate this 10th day of February, 2026.
ALVINA REYNOLDS,
President of the Senate.
SAINT LUCIA
